main_text.l: Et acriter reprehendit Vegam, qui libro 15. de Justific. cap. 9. tam

rus sit. Nam primo, inquit, respondeo, istiusmodi declarationum, sive
judicum sententia, sive Doctorum opiniones, sive sapientum responsa, sive

operaque alia, ac istarum heruς haretici fuerunt, &c. Sed frustra
